question: In which city of India was the AIFF-FIFA Football Academy launched in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhubaneshwar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The AIFF-FIFA Football Academy was launched in **Bhubaneshwar, Odisha, in 2023** to promote football infrastructure and nurture young talent in India.
 
• Bhubaneshwar is recognized as a **sports hub** in India, having hosted major events like the Hockey World Cup and Indian Super League (ISL) matches.
 
• The academy is a part of the collaboration between the **All India Football Federation (AIFF)** and **FIFA** to strengthen grassroots football and provide advanced training facilities in the country.
 
• This initiative aligns with the Indian government’s vision to enhance sports infrastructure and make India more competitive in global football.
 
• The academy aims to train young football players through modern techniques, experienced coaches, and state-of-the-art facilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhubaneshwar as a Sports Hub:**

 
 
• Bhubaneshwar has gained prominence as a model city for sports development due to its world-class facilities, such as the **Kalinga Stadium**.
 
• The city has hosted prestigious events like the **Men’s Hockey World Cup (2018 and 2023)** and ISL matches, establishing itself as a center for international sports.
 
• The Odisha government has actively invested in upgrading sports infrastructure and promoting youth participation in sports.
 
 
 
• **All India Football Federation (AIFF):**
 
 
• The AIFF is the governing body for football in India and is affiliated with **FIFA** and the **Asian Football Confederation (AFC)**.
 
• Its initiatives include organizing leagues like the Indian Super League (ISL) and I-League, as well as grassroots and youth development programs.
 
• The AIFF’s collaboration with FIFA aims to boost football development in India and enhance its global competitiveness.
 
 
 
• **FIFA’s Role in Football Development:**
 
 
• FIFA provides financial and technical support to member associations like AIFF for developing football infrastructure and grassroots programs.
 
• Programs like **FIFA Forward** focus on sustainable football growth and increasing participation worldwide.
 
• FIFA emphasizes inclusivity, ensuring that football is accessible to all, regardless of socioeconomic status.
